MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Nova Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 3.0-Tesla
• Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 25 T/m
• Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.2 W/kg
• RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Nova Vena Cava Filter is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
